edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial owner, so the deployer's identity controls ownership.
Constructor calls OwnableStorage.setOwner to persist the initial owner.
msg.sender flows into setOwner, granting ownership privileges to the caller.
setOwner writes the owner state variable used by onlyOwner checks.
Constructor stores the initial delegatecall implementation address.
Constructor parameter implementation is written to the implementation state variable.
Constructor parameter chonkyAttributes is written to storage.
Constructor parameter chonkyMetadata is written to storage.
Constructor parameter chonkySet is written to storage.
Constructor sets the NFT name and symbol metadata.
Constructor registers supported ERC165 interfaces via setSupportedInterface.
setSupportedInterface writes the supportedInterfaces mapping.
interfaceId parameter flows into the interface registration.
status parameter flows into the interface registration.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner before allowing execution.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for authorization.
setImplementation is guarded by onlyOwner, a critical upgrade authorization path.
SafeOwnable.transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
Ownable.transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
New implementation parameter is supplied to the upgrade function.
setImplementation writes the new implementation address into storage.
setImplementation reads the previous implementation to emit the Upgraded event.
Current implementation is cached into the oldImplementation local.
Fallback resolves the implementation through _getImplementation.
_getImplementation reads the implementation state variable.
getImplementation delegates to _getImplementation.
Fallback execution reaches the raw delegatecall region.
The stored implementation address feeds the delegatecall target.
delegatecall forwards execution to the implementation address holder.
Account parameter selects the new nominee owner.
SafeOwnable.transferOwnership sets the nominee instead of transferring directly.
Account parameter is written as the nominee owner.
setNomineeOwner writes the nomineeOwner state variable.
onlyNomineeOwner reads the nomineeOwner state variable.
onlyNomineeOwner compares msg.sender to the stored nominee owner.
acceptOwnership is guarded by onlyNomineeOwner.
acceptOwnership updates ownership storage.
acceptOwnership reads the current owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
acceptOwnership clears the nominee owner after transfer.
Account parameter becomes the new owner in direct transferOwnership.
Ownable.transferOwnership writes the new owner through setOwner.
Payable account parameter is used as the value transfer recipient.
Amount parameter determines how much native value is sent.
sendValue reaches the low-level call operation.
Low-level native transfer invokes the recipient account, which may be attacker-controlled.
functionCallWithValue delegates to _functionCallWithValue.
Target parameter flows into the low-level call path.
Data parameter flows into the low-level call path.
Value parameter flows into the low-level call path.
_functionCallWithValue reaches the low-level call operation.
Low-level call invokes the target contract, executing arbitrary code.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor implementation parameter is only meaningful for the initialization performed by the constructor.
Constructor attribute address parameter is assigned to storage within the constructor.
Constructor metadata address parameter is assigned to storage within the constructor.
Constructor set address parameter is assigned to storage within the constructor.
Upgrade implementation parameter is consumed by setImplementation.
Nominee account parameter is consumed by SafeOwnable.transferOwnership.
Recipient account parameter is consumed by sendValue.
Amount parameter is consumed by sendValue.
Call target parameter is consumed by _functionCallWithValue.
Call data parameter is consumed by _functionCallWithValue.
Call value parameter is consumed by _functionCallWithValue.
Interface id parameter is consumed by setSupportedInterface.
Support status parameter is consumed by setSupportedInterface.
Owner parameter is written by setOwner.
Nominee parameter is written by setNomineeOwner.
Cached previous implementation local is only used inside setImplementation.
Cached implementation local is only used inside the fallback.
Call success local is only used inside sendValue.
Return data local is only used inside _functionCallWithValue for revert bubbling.
Direct transfer account parameter is consumed by Ownable.transferOwnership.
